findings.description: [defect] In PRIORITY TRIAGE on desktop (00-desktop-top.png, 01-desktop-full.png), the right card (WRN-119) is narrower than the left card (INC-408), causing its "Last deploy" metric to wrap onto an orphan second row. This vertically misaligns the two Inspect buttons and leaves unused empty space at the bottom of the INC-408 card.

[defect] In LAST 24 HOURS (01-desktop-full.png), the "Deploys vs failed (per hour)" bar chart uses fractional Y-axis ticks (2.2, 4.4) for integer deploy counts, and the companion charts display unrounded Y-axis ticks (673/337, 5.3/2.7) with no 0 baseline tick.

[defect] In RECENT DEPLOYS (01-desktop-full.png), the compact right-hand detail card (rel-837) occupies roughly the top 30% of the column height alongside 8 deploy rows, leaving a large empty region (~70% of the right column) below it; a smaller vertical imbalance (~45% empty) also appears below the detail card in SERVICE SLO HEALTH.

[defect] In LAST 24 HOURS (00-desktop-top.png, 01-desktop-full.png), the bordered narrative callout box ("Shift at 06:00Z...") stops at roughly 72% of the container width with no sibling content beside it, breaking right-edge alignment with the full-width slider and chart grid below.

[defect] Line wrapping splits paired tokens in two places: in the SERVICE SLO HEALTH detail card (01-desktop-full.png), "612 ms vs 250 ms (+362 ms)" breaks between "250" and "ms", and in the mobile header (02-mobile-top.png), "window 24h" wraps to leave "24h" orphaned on a second line.

[suggestion] In BUILD RUNNER POOLS (01-desktop-full.png), each card renders a thin amber horizontal bar at the bottom beneath Utilization/Queued/Avg wait without a label or legend explaining the metric it represents.

verdict.summary: Approved for the reviewed desktop and mobile views. The Fleet Dashboard has a cohesive visual hierarchy, clear typography, varied data-visualization sections, and clean mobile stacking with no critical or major defects. Only minor polish issues were observed, including asymmetric Priority Triage metric wrapping, fractional/unrounded chart Y-axis ticks, empty vertical space beneath master-detail inspector cards, a non-full-width callout box, minor token wrapping, and an unlabeled secondary bar in runner pool cards.
